rationale: The file contains a valid HLF transaction entrypoint (Init and Invoke methods on the Contract struct implementing the contractapi pattern). However, the Init and Invoke methods themselves contain no consensus-critical nondeterminism sources. Init performs only parameter validation and returns success. Invoke is a dispatcher that routes to other methods based on function name, with no local logic that reads from time, goroutines, maps, queries, or mutable globals. The actual transaction logic resides in the delegated methods (DeleteContract, QueryContractState, etc.), which are not defined in this file and therefore outside the scope of intra-file analysis. No C1–C6 vulnerabilities are present in the code shown.
